tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exception for disabling it. Testing that needs a certificate the system does not already trust uses self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off. The project also records a decision of HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception, since certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the current decision.

It says TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included, with no exception for turning it off. Testing uses self-signed certificates instead of disabling verification. The paragraph also notes the later HTTPS-everywhere decision, which allows no plaintext exception.

I wrote it from Muninn decisions #31, #32 and #35 and left out the retired dev-build exception. Muninn also flagged that seven hook runs started and never finished, so a hook may be exceeding its timeout. The details are in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
